sentences.sentence: I wonder what was on the other side of my kitchen cabinets.
The cabinet world looked like the inside of my cabinet but much bigger.
The bag of rice was as big as a mountain.
I saw some strange people who were talking to each other.
They were plates and spoons that could talk.
I felt really excited while I was in the cabinet world.
I decided to stay there and explore some more.
I would love to go back to the cabinet world again.
